existingSolutions.addresses: Shop floor management, paperless documentation, real-time quality inspection monitoring, certification management, and First Article Inspection Report (FAIR) generation.
5-axis CNC programming and full machine code simulation.

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Creations Unlimited is outside ForgeX's target segment of home-service contractors and already operates specialized manufacturing ERP/QMS software (ProShop).

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended for this business.

risks.description: The company states it holds ITAR Registration and AS9100D certification for aerospace, space, and medical machining; any third-party cloud or AI automation handling technical drawings, quotes, or customer communications would face strict ITAR/export-control and quality compliance constraints.

ForgeX's core offerings are built around home-service field-service software, consumer lead intake, and QuickBooks reporting, which do not align with B2B aerospace/medical CNC machine shop workflows in ProShop ERP.

qualification.rationale: Creations Unlimited is a B2B 5-axis precision CNC machine shop serving aerospace, space, medical, and hi-tech manufacturing clients, placing it outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led residential home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical). Furthermore, the company already operates a paperless shop floor and integrated QMS using ProShop ERP alongside robotic CNC automation.
